author: John Hammond
description:
Testing the Broken Pipe proof of concept for a Steam local privilege escalation vulnerability.

The objective is to determine whether a low-privileged user can exploit the vulnerability to execute a shell as `NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM`.

Full video: https://youtu.be/oJHOlNTH7lY?si=8LruOkxZlfvFLII-
title: Steam Local Privilege Escalation
